_note: Model chain for the agent. Live order (owner, 2026-11-08): gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3.8-flash. First enabled entry is primary; the other enabled entries are fallbacks in order. Entries with "enabled": false are kept for testing but are never built into the live chain, listed as fallbacks or shown in /api/health and /api/quota. Groq gpt-oss-120b is disabled (2026-11-08) until the full 15-question Groq test is done; run it with scripts/run_eval.py --set groq, which builds a Groq-only chain explicitly. Env SKYQ_MODEL_CHAIN (e.g. 'google:gemini-3.5-flash-lite,google:gemini-3.1-flash-lite') replaces the chain for local tests. Keys come from .env only. Verified 2026-11-05: Groq key serves gpt-oss-120b/20b, qwen3.8-27b (llama-3.3-70b returns 404); Gemini 2.5 Flash is retired for new users. gpt-oss-120b needs reasoning_effort 'medium': with 'low', Groq rejected 3/3 answers (output_parse_failed); medium answered 3/3. 2026-11-06: gemini-3.1-flash-lite added after a 13-question sample (13/14 turns; the miss was a wording check) and a provider 429 showing its quota is per model. gemini-3.8-flash stays last resort (20 RPD).

free_tier_checked_2026_11_05.google: Per-model free-tier quotas from the owner's AI Studio (2026-11-06; usage there is a 28-day peak). Provider 429 bodies name the quota per project per model.

limits._note: max_tokens_per_question is the one per-question token cap (12,000, set 2026-11-08). The API uses it as the hard cap and the shared quota reserves the same amount for each new question, so a question can never use more than it reserved. Measured max on current code: 9,825 tokens (holdout2 first pass); mean about 4,200-5,500. Env TOKENS_PER_QUESTION may only lower it. model_request_timeout_s: each single model request (including the SDK's own retries) is stopped after this many seconds and the chain moves to the next model; the whole question still stops at QUESTION_TIMEOUT_S (60 s).

quota._note: Shared limits for all visitors (backend/agent/quota.py). Effective cap = provider limit x safety_margin; public visitors stop at (1 - demo_reserve) of the daily caps, demo requests may use the reserve. Override per model with env SKYQ_PROVIDER_LIMITS='{"google:gemini-3.5-flash-lite":{"rpd":1000}}', or SKYQ_QUOTA_SAFETY_MARGIN / SKYQ_DEMO_RESERVE. question_requests = measured max model requests per question (scripts/measure_requests.py). The per-question token reservation equals limits.max_tokens_per_question.
